proposals.title: Equal Voting Rights for Each Shareholder
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to ensure all outstanding stock has one vote per share, including encouraging holders of multiple-vote shares to relinquish preexisting rights.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 5 because it is not in the best interests of Ford and you.

proposals.title: Transparent Lobbying Disclosure
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing Ford's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, recipients, and Board oversight of lobbying payments.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 6 because it is not in the best interests of Ford and you.

proposals.title: Not stated
proposals.proponent: As You Sow on behalf of the Arkay Foundation
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on whether Ford's fleet GHG emissions through 2025 will increase given fleet mix changes and proposed CAFE weakening, and how it will retain consistent emissions.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 7 because it is not in the best interests of Ford and you.

proposals.title: Transparent Political Spending
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden on behalf of James McRitchie
proposals.topic_summary: Requests semiannual reporting of policies and of corporate political contributions and expenditures, including recipients, amounts, and decision-makers, excluding lobbying.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 8 because it is not in the best interests of Ford and you.
